verdict.rationale: Zapier documents building 'specialized agents' that connect to business data and take actions across 9,000+ apps (zapier-docs-8), and its MCP layer lets external AI clients trigger real actions with tool use (zapier-docs-24, zapier-docs-25). However, there's no evidence of an in-workflow 'AI/LLM step' with explicit model choice (e.g., picking GPT-4 vs Claude) inside a Zap builder—only agent creation via Copilot and AI-assisted troubleshooting (zapier-docs-10). missing for 10: documented in-Zap AI/LLM action step with selectable model, and independent hands-on confirmation of model choice/tool use within a single workflow.
